help.body:
1. Open Settings → PandaScore token and connect your personal token.
2. Choose team or tournament search.
3. Reply to the bot's message with a name.
4. For a tournament, select the whole season — for example, Esports World Cup · 2026. The bot will collect matches from all its stages.
5. Open a team or tournament and switch between upcoming, live and results. Results contain only finished matches. Every match shows its stage; available upcoming or live broadcasts are linked.
6. Tap ☆ to save a team or the whole tournament to favorites.
7. If Telegram shows UTC, open Settings → Time zone and enter your offset once.

home.readyBody:
Find a team or tournament to see upcoming matches and recent results.

A tournament includes matches from all of its stages; each match shows its exact stage.

⭐ Save anything you follow to favorites and open it again in one tap.

Where should we start?
home.setupBody:
The bot shows schedules and results for teams and tournaments and saves the ones you follow to favorites.

It needs a free personal PandaScore token. Getting one takes a couple of minutes — start with the button below.
home.title: Dota 2 schedule

prompt.series:
🏆 Tournament search

Reply to this message with a name. For example: Esports World Cup 2026, The International or ESL One.
prompt.team:
🔎 Team search

Reply to this message with a name. For example: Team Spirit, OG or Liquid.
prompt.timezone:
🕐 Time zone

Telegram does not share your time zone with bots. Reply with your UTC offset — for example, +6, -3 or +5:30. To let Telegram localize dates again, send ‘auto’.
prompt.token:
🔐 Connect PandaScore

Reply to this message with your token. The bot will immediately try to delete the secret message, validate the token and store it encrypted.
